title: Let the deeper fear swallow the lesser ones
summary: Let mercy steady the breath before fear writes the day. Let this stay near the next choice: carry this with you: taste Naam deeply enough that lesser fears stop governing you.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Deeper reverence makes the smaller fears fall quietly away.
source.lifeApplication: When fear multiplies, stay with the line until the smaller ones begin to thin.
